# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting is currently disabled for this repository. When enabled, use GitHub **Security → Report a vulnerability** as the primary channel.

Until then, email `nexa.business.contact@gmail.com` with subject `[SECURITY][api] concise vulnerability title`.

Include:

- repository and version;
- affected component;
- impact;
- reproduction steps;
- a safe proof of concept;
- suggested mitigation;
- investigator availability for collaboration.

Do not send real tokens, passwords, personal data, production data or destructive exploit instructions.

Do not report security issues through public issues. We will acknowledge receipt when possible, coordinate investigation privately and avoid publishing details before mitigation is available.

## Supported versions

| Version | Support |
|---|---|
| `0.9.x` | Supported |
| `< 0.9` | Unsupported |
